text:
mia_nguyen: Heads up — PioneerLogistics flagged as renewal watch. Q4 baseline usage dropped ~80% last 30 days and procurement mentioned a pilot with AtlasAI. Putting this here to coordinate next steps.
jordan_lee: ugh. when did the drop start? any correlation with onboarding changes or SSO? :eyes:
mi a_nguyen: drop starts ~2026-02-10. onboarding finished Jan but they switched to our smaller model variant for latency. usage went from `last_30d: 120k tokens` to `12k tokens`.
samira_cs: I just spoke to their CSM contact (Ayesha). She said procurement is testing Atlas for cost. They liked Atlas' one-click batching demo. Ayesha is worried about token costs.
toby_solutions: @jordan_lee can we pull per-route token cost + latency for PioneerLogistics (last 90d)? need to show unit economics vs Atlas.
kevin_eng: on it. Will export per-route breakdown and top 5 endpoints by call volume. ETA 30m.
nora_pm: also capture any recent regressions in generation quality — they mentioned hallucination issues last month. Samira, did they file any evals?
samira_cs: they submitted two evals in Jan. One flagged occasional hallucinations for invoice parsing. Attached notes in the CRM.
mia_nguyen: Proposed play: 1) immediate exec review with their CS + procurement 2) offer 3-month discounted commit on Dedicated to match cost 3) dedicated onboarding from Toby to test batching and cheap quantized variant 4) expand eval suite to address hallucination. Thoughts? :handshake:
jordan_lee: agree. emphasize predictability + SLAs. If they want cost comparison, show live perf numbers and our recommended batching settings.
toby_solutions: I'll scope a 2-week POC config: continuous batching + prefix caching. Will run a smoke run for their top 3 routes.
kevin_eng: exported data posted to #infra-exports: `s3://redwood-exports/pioneer/1945678901/` (deploy-bot confirmed).
deploy-bot: export job 7892 completed. 3 files (usage.csv, routes.csv, evals.json).
samira_cs: I'll schedule a meeting with Ayesha + their procurement for next Tue 10am PT. Sharing proposed agenda and ask list.
nora_pm: I'll draft an outcomes checklist for renewal (cost bound, quality pass, exec signoff). Share by EOD.
mia_nguyen: Thanks team. Samira — let me know if procurement will accept a short price-match clause. If meeting goes well, I can loop in sales for a custom term.
samira_cs: noted. Will confirm and post follow-up notes in thread after the call.
jordan_lee: tagging past case owner @kevin_eng for any recent infra incidents that could explain quality blips.
kevin_eng: no infra incidents in window. quality likely model/config. I'll attach model variant diffs.
mia_nguyen: Action items: Samira schedule, Kevin attach diffs/export, Toby prep POC config, Nora draft checklist, Jordan assemble cost comparison doc. Update thread when complete. :white_check_mark:
